title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 48
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 48: the judgment on Moab, its cities and its god, the wailing over it and the word about the latter days.

questions.text: The word at the head of this chapter is about which nation?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 48:1 opens: Of Moab. Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Woe to Nebo!

answers.text: Moab
Ammon
Edom
Philistia

questions.text: Which place does verse 1 say is put to shame and broken down?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Nebo is laid waste, Kiriathaim is disappointed and taken, and Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

answers.text: Heshbon
Horonaim
Misgab
Kerioth

questions.text: Which god will go out into captivity with his priests and his princes?
questions.explanation: Because Moab trusted in his works and his treasures, he will be taken, and Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

answers.text: Bel
Chemosh
Malcam
Merodach

questions.text: What are the people told to be like when they flee to save their lives?
questions.explanation: They are told to flee and save their lives, and to be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.

answers.text: Like the eagle in the sky
Like the lion in the forest
Like the cedar of Lebanon
Like the juniper bush in the wilderness

questions.text: How does verse 11 describe Moab from his youth?
questions.explanation: Moab has been at ease from his youth, settled on his lees, never emptied from vessel to vessel and never gone into captivity.

answers.text: At ease, settled on his lees and never emptied from vessel to vessel
A wanderer with no place of his own among the nations
A servant of the house of Israel from his youth
Always at war with the nations around him

questions.text: Who is told to come down from her glory and sit in thirst?
questions.explanation: The daughter who dwells in Dibon is told to come down from her glory and sit in thirst, for the destroyer of Moab has come up against her.

answers.text: The daughter who dwells in Heshbon
The inhabitant of Aroer
The daughter who dwells in Dibon
The men of Kir Heres

questions.text: What of Moab is cut off, and what is broken?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says the horn of Moab is cut off and his arm is broken.

answers.text: His crown is taken and his throne is broken
His bow is broken and his shield is cut off
His gates are burned and his bars are broken
His horn is cut off and his arm is broken

questions.text: What bird are the inhabitants of Moab told to be like?
questions.explanation: They are told to leave the cities, dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

answers.text: The eagle that makes her nest in the high clefts
The dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss
The ostrich that leaves her eggs in the desert
The sparrow that sits alone on the housetop

questions.text: What does verse 37 say about every head and every beard?
questions.explanation: Every head is bald and every beard clipped, with cuttings on all the hands and sackcloth on the waist.

answers.text: Every head is bald and every beard is clipped
Every head is lifted up and every beard is washed
Every head wears a helmet and every beard is long
Every head is anointed and every beard perfumed

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do for Moab in the latter days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days.

answers.text: Destroy Moab so that it is never named again
Give the land of Moab to the Ammonites
Reverse the captivity of Moab
Restore Chemosh to his place
